ov: مذكرات كرة السلة (الإنجليزية: Basketball Diaries) هو فيلم سيرة ذاتية درامية وجريمة أمريكي صدر عام 1995 يستند في قصته إلى رواية تحمل نفس الاسم للكاتب والمغني الراحل جيم كارول، الفيلم من إخراج سكوت كليفرت وبطولة ليوناردو دي كابريو و‌مارك والبيرغ.
plotEn:
Teenager Jim Carroll is a high school basketball player who regularly gets into mischief with his friends Pedro, Mickey and Neutron on the streets of New York City and at school. Outside of basketball, Jim shows an artistic interest in writing, keeping his work in a journal while expressing his thoughts and creating poetry. During a game Pedro steals money, watches and a ring from the other team's lockers. Afterward the other team tracks Jim and his friends at a restaurant and a fight breaks out. An acquaintance of the four named Diane is prostituting herself to the group to financially support her addiction. 
Jim's best friend, Bobby, is dying of leukemia, and Jim frequently visits him in the hospital. One night Jim sneaks Bobby out of the hospital and takes him to a stripper and Bobby doesn't enjoy his experience and Jim brings him back to the hospital. 
The four friends go out to the cliffs and jump into the Harlem river and moon passing boats. After they are finished swimming Neutron takes Jim to an apartment with twin sisters known as Winkie and Blinkie. Blinkie introduces Jim to cocaine and they later have sex. He later raids the medicine cabinet in their apartment and takes some pills.
